- Executes one RPC request through the shared runtime; nil input uses zero values unless required. Callers must not mutate input concurrently.
- Input required: `true`; idempotent: `false`.

| Input | Go | Wire | Guidance |

| DurationSeconds | `int64` | `DurationSeconds` | Specifies the token lifetime; zero omits it (service default 3600), nonzero must be at least 900. The role maximum is a service decision. |
